ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85:15 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.

Discrete high-contrast white mottling and irregular blobs are localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes. Multiple small, high-intensity circular focal spots are scattered across the dark central field.
